0x0007F0.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000861.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008E9.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000992.en: 「Tch!! What a lousy way to bow out!」

0x000A12.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A4A.en: 「Uh-oh...@　Not my finest hour, is it!」

0x000B4E.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This is no fun...」

0x000BA2.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CF3.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is on you.」

0x000D25.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000D9F.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DEC.en: 「Well, I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E2A.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E71.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F1C.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x000FD3.en: 「Owowow... I give up, my math was off.」

0x0010C5.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00110C.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001141.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00122D.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still too green...!」

0x00127B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0012F4.en: 「Sorry, everyone!@　I'm gonna have to bail...!」

0x001336.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001365.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013A3.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x0013D2.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00145D.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll have to pull back...!」

0x001681.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018C5.en: 「All I can do is fall back...!」

0x001915.en: （...If what Mekibos said is true,@　then we have no cause left...）

0x001977.en: (At this rate we'll be fighting our own homeland,@ not just the Earth forces. Lord Zezernan would@ hardly want that)

0x001A28.en: (...No, I can't imagine that man@ accepting the truth so easily.@ I'd best get word to Seti and Zeb first...)

0x001B11.en: 「S-so that's it, Zezernan!@　Y-you meant to do this to me...!!」

0x001BC7.en: 「Hold ooon a sec.@　I'm kinda in the middle of something too, ya knoow.」

0x001C1A.en: 「...That is the Privy Council's decision.@ Let me hear your answer, Lord Zezernan.」

0x001D01.en: 「Yes.@　It's been a while, Justine Chafrois.」

0x001D54.en: 「A special envoy of the Privy Council now, are yaa?@　Moved up in the world, Meki-chaan.」

0x001DEA.en: 「Aw, coome on, you could call me Zeb-chan@　like the old days, cooouldn't ya?」

0x001E58.en: 「...That was ages ago.@　More to the point, Grofis Delfarte@　should have returned to you...」

0x001EDC.en: 「What are you talking about!?@　You're the ones who shot down the Zeidram!!」

0x001F94.en: 「So the Earth forces finished off Grofis Lacrein.@　Or perhaps you pulled the strings.」

0x002017.en: 「For that matter, wasn't it you who leaked@　the timing of our first Earth descent operation?」

0x00209D.en: 「Just like Wendro before...@　Such methods run in the Bolqueede blood.@　Whatever the case, I can't trust a word you say.」

0x002142.en: 「I've shown you the Privy Council's writ of appointment@　and proof of what you planted in the Granzon, haven't I?」

0x0021F4.en: 「And what am I supposed to have planted? I know nothing of it.」

0x002265.en: 「A fabrication by the Council's Walga faction, no doubt.@　You'd frame me to wipe away Wendro's failure.」

0x0022EE.en: 「Wrong. The Council is reconsidering the very method@　by which we contact the Earthlings.」

0x002353.en: 「You mean grant those savage Earth apes@　third-class limited autonomy?@　Absurd.」

0x0023CE.en: 「It was the Council that decreed the alien-culture audit.@　I am carrying out the plan in accordance with it.」

0x00244E.en: 「You yourself should recognize that Earth@　is the cancer of this galaxy.」

0x0024B0.en: 「Our battles changed that thinking.@　That's all.」

0x002522.en: 「Unfortunately, I'm not the only one.@　There are others who question your methods.@　Beyond Walga, too.」

0x0025B8.en: 「A recall order was issued taking all of that into account,@　and I've been dispatched as envoy.」

0x002635.en: 「Refuse the Council's order,@　and you'll be branded a traitor.」

0x002697.en: 「Were the envoy anyone but a Zogar or Walga man,@　it might carry more weight.」

0x0026FC.en: 「But behind this scheme to pin false crimes on me@　and bring me down, I glimpse Walga's designs@　to expand its power.」

0x00279B.en: 「I was named envoy on the strength of my record@　carrying out missions in Earth's sphere. Walga's aims@　or convenience have nothing to do with it.」

0x00284F.en: 「A man of House Bolqueede could never abandon Walga.@　Nor the reverse.」

0x0028C0.en: 「Otherwise, Wendro would never have been named@　an alien-culture auditor at that age.」

0x00292E.en: 「And after being shot by that same Wendro, half-dead...@　what awaited my return@　was Walga's cold treatment.」

0x0029CD.en: 「They pinned all the blame on me and cast me out of the faction.@　Behind it were those who sought@　House Bolqueede's downfall.」

0x002A78.en: 「My line had many enemies...@　Wendro's life was threatened more than once or twice.@　This scar on my face is proof of it.」

0x002B26.en: 「Great house or no, once two brothers both fail,@　those around you turn on you in an instant. To save their own skins.」

0x002BBE.en: 「And so you contacted the Council to make your comeback?」

0x002C04.en: 「Just the way you'd think.@　I grew sick of the squabbling between factions and houses.@　And I've no reason left to be bound by it.」

0x002CA9.en: 「Nonsense.@　You're being used by a faction even now.」

0x002CF6.en: 「...Perhaps so, but that goes both ways.@　You'd do well to consider why I've come@　leading an army in the Council's name.」

0x002D98.en: 「Disarm and accept the recall order, or I attack.@　Just so we're clear -- taking the Moon's@　Earthlings hostage will get you nowhere.」

0x002E55.en: 「Defy the Council's order and then slaughter Earthlings,@　and you'll only delight Walga. They'll have their excuse@　to go after Zogar.」

0x002F0C.en: 「Think it over, Teniquette Zezernan.@　This is the turning point.」

0x002F7D.en: 「...Bring all mobile weapons for the second descent online at once.@　Deploy them in the skies above the Moon Cradle.」

0x002FFA.en: 「You'd refuse the Council's order?@　Then we become traitors...!」

0x003062.en: 「Don't you see?@　The homeland has cast us aside.」

0x0030B2.en: 「By rights, word should come through the proper channels.@　But when the Council sends an envoy and forces@　directly, that can only mean...」

0x00315D.en: 「Zogar couldn't stop it...@　nooo, maybe they never meant to stop it at all.」

0x0031D7.en: 「But why?@ To cast aside Lord Zezernan, a pillar of Zogar,@ just like that...」

0x003258.en: 「That thing Meki-chan mentioned earlier,@　planted in the Granzon... if that's truue...」

0x0032D2.en: (! Back then, Roff and I were forbidden@ from hearing Lord Zezernan and Shu Shirakawa's talk...@ Could it be...?)

0x00337D.en: 「Don't believe Mekibos's nonsense.@　I know full well what punishment awaits@　anyone who uses that thing.」

0x003410.en: 「...Then why not accept the recall@　and plead your case in the homeland?」

0x003481.en: 「Hmph, do that and worst case I could be erased.@　Just like Grofis Lacrein.」

0x003521.en: 「Once I defeat Mekibos, I'll seize Earth's sphere and claim the military tech the apes built, plus what came from other worlds.」

0x0035CF.en: 「Do that, and the homeland's attitude will change.@　There's no shortage of men who'll swarm to@　off-world interests and new technology.」

0x0036A5.en: 「That's a passing problem.@　Throw away all we've achieved, go home and be condemned...@　or carve your own path. There's nothing to agonize over.」

0x00375F.en: 「...I've no grudge against Meki-chan,@　but I'll pass on being a throwaway pawn.」

0x003816.en: 「...I can't forgive the ones@　who killed Roff...」

0x003869.en: 「Then you two intercept Mekibos.@　I'll bring the Baran Schnail online.」

0x0038DD.en: 「You'd deploy that as well?@　Wasn't it the trump card for the later Earth conquest...?」

0x00393F.en: 「First we must win this battle.@　I'm counting on you to fight well.」

0x0039E8.en: （...Hmph, the timing's merely moved up.@　I didn't expect the Council to act...@　but it's the spark to sweep away the opposition.）

0x003A90.en: （The same for those fence-sitters in Zogar@　who tried to discard me...）

0x003AF2.en: （Once I've taken Earth in hand,@　I'll look forward to seeing what faces you all wear@　when you next come crawling to me...）

0x003BB6.en: 「Will Teniquette Zezernan@　answer the recall order...?」

0x003C1E.en: 「From the look of him, no.@　He's the one who killed Roff, most likely.@　To silence him.」

0x003C99.en: 「I was careless... to think he'd move that fast...@　I never should have let him go alone...」

0x003D25.en: 「Won't Zogar's people persuade Zezernan@ to obey the order?」

0x003D84.en: 「Back home the Granzon business is already out in the open.@　Zogar's people are scrambling to dodge the blame.」

0x003E0D.en: 「Planting that thing was Zezernan's own doing...@ well, that part's true, but they're spinning it@ to keep the fallout on the faction to a minimum.」

0x003ED9.en: 「So he's been cut loose by his own people.」

0x003F19.en: 「Right.@ Cover for Zezernan now and they'd all go down with him.」

0x003F8B.en: 「They're using the fact that he holds full authority over Earth's expedition and is off-world to pin all the blame on him.」

0x004027.en: 「If anything, part of them hopes I'll be the one@ to take Zezernan down. Dead men tell no tales.」

0x0040BD.en: 「La Gias, Zovorg... no matter the world,@　seems the same kind of squabbles@　break out everywhere.」

0x004153.en: 「Our world holds together by star system...@　but the whole Republic Alliance is another matter.」

0x0041BE.en: 「So what's Zezernan planning to do now?」

0x004204.en: 「With the Granzon business out in the open,@　if he obeys the recall and goes home, that's the end of him.」

0x004287.en: 「He'll dig in his heels, beat us, and squat in Earth's sphere...@　then exploit the chaos to seize control.」

0x00431C.en: 「The Ruina and Baral's appearance was surely unexpected... but now it suits him. He'll size things up before he strikes again.」

0x0043CD.en: 「So after the first descent operation failed,@　the reason they barely touched Earth was...」

0x004450.en: 「They're wary of the likes of the <Einst>.@　We took a nasty beating from them once too.」

0x0044DE.en: 「That's why Zezernan stayed put on the Moon as much as he could, watching how the fight between Earth, Ruina, and Baral played out.」

0x00457D.en: 「The last one standing takes the win... that's his aim?」

0x0045C0.en: 「Most likely. Then he seizes Earth's sphere,@　sells what he gains to Zovorg's war merchants,@　and uses that to lean on the Privy Council.」

0x00468F.en: 「Well, that was his goal from the start, I'd say.」

0x0046D8.en: 「Officially, keeping galactic order.@　Really, grabbing money and power.」

0x004734.en: 「Good grief. Calls us lower life-forms and apes,@　yet what he's up to is no different@　from Earth's own shady politicians.」

0x0047DC.en: 「Quite. Makes me feel a strange kinship@　with the Zovorg in a whole other way.」

0x00483B.en: 「...If they knew Zezernan would snap like this,@ they should've sent an army big enough@ to make him scream.」

0x0048E3.en: 「We've got our own circumstances.@　There's a limit to the forces we can spare for a frontier conflict.」

0x004954.en: 「Frontier, he says. So do you actually intend@　to solve this problem or not?@　Which is it?」

0x0049DE.en: 「Rare for the Council to decide so fast, actually...@　but I suppose saying that won't satisfy you.」

0x004A64.en: 「Drop the killing blow on Zezernan first,@ and then I might just let it slide.」

0x004ACF.en: 「No, we can't. That would risk@　destroying Moon Cradle itself.」

0x004B3A.en: 「...Mekibos, what about the chance that@　Zezernan takes the lunar residents hostage?」

0x004BA5.en: 「I've already warned him off that.@　Besides, he means to make Earth's sphere@　his own power base...」

0x004C29.en: 「He knows that slaughtering civilians@　would needlessly turn the locals against him@　and cause trouble down the line.」

0x004CC8.en: 「The moment he launched an invasion,@　there's no 'turning them against him' left.」

0x004D27.en: 「True enough...@　but we don't condone laying hands on civilians.」

0x004D92.en: 「We crush rival military forces to set an example,@　but preserve anything with production capacity.@　What we can absorb, we absorb.」

0x004E34.en: 「A wise general feeds off the enemy... Sun Tzu, was it?@　That's the gist of it.」

0x004EBB.en: 「It means a good commander on campaign@　provisions his food and arms from the enemy.」

0x004F51.en: 「No, we avoid looting or slaughtering civilians.@ It only tightens the noose around our own necks.@ A doctrine born of the Republic's long history.」

0x005020.en: 「That's why our forces are made up almost@　entirely of Bioroids we can keep in check.」

0x005097.en: 「A skilled fighter seeks victory in momentum, not in his men...@　It makes that kind of thing easier, too.」

0x005114.en: 「True enough...@　soldiers with no ego, moving only as ordered.」

0x005167.en: 「I've thought so for a while now.@　You've studied our culture quite well.」

0x0051D8.en: 「I was an alien-culture inspector.@　Zezernan did his homework thoroughly too.@　So he could try to settle things through negotiation first.」

0x00528F.en: 「If Shu Shirakawa hadn't caused the <Antarctic Incident>,@ his plan would be a stage on by now.@ And we'd never have come to Earth.」

0x00535D.en: 「Tch. Nothing good ever comes of that man's involvement.」

0x0053AC.en: 「Can't say that for certain.@　It was that very man who set the fall@　of Zezernan in motion, after all.」

0x00542D.en: 「I don't want to think I owe Shu anything!」

0x005470.en: 「...In any case, we can assume the chance of Zezernan@　harming the lunar residents is low. That's your read?」

0x005500.en: 「But if he killed Roff to save his own skin...@　cornered, he might do something reckless.」

0x005595.en: 「Can't deny that.@　Which is why we need to move fast.」

0x0055F1.en: （Well, taking Earthling hostages@　wouldn't get him anywhere against this one...）

0x005662.en: 「From here on it's a family quarrel.@　You lot don't need to join the fight.@　I know about the trouble on Earth too.」

0x005729.en: 「I'll consult with Commander Humphrey.@　All hands, remain at Combat Condition Two.」

0x0057BD.en: 「...I can't take an alien's word at face value,@　but if it spares us from wearing down our own forces here,@　nothing could be better.」

0x00586E.en: 「Still, we must keep watch on Mekibos Borquede.@　There's a chance he'll turn on us.」

0x0058DF.en: 「And so... we of the Steel Dragon Squadron intend@　to descend on Moon Cradle together with Mekibos.」

0x005962.en: 「What? You'd lend the aliens a hand?」

0x005993.en: 「Yes, to swiftly cut off any threat at our backs.@　And we must keep the damage@　to Moon Cradle to a minimum.」

0x005A3B.en: 「Pulling chestnuts from the fire, is it.」

0x005A69.en: 「Throwing ourselves into the tiger's mouth@　is the Steel Dragon Squadron's duty as well.」

0x005AC2.en: 「...To deal with the crisis in Earth's sphere,@　we've no choice but to settle with the Guests quickly...」

0x005B4E.en: 「Very well. I approve your request.@　My First Fleet will hold to the rear@　and stand ready for the unexpected.」

0x005BD8.en: 「The Second Fleet will retake the lunar city as planned,@　with the Third Fleet providing support.」

0x005C40.en: 「Understood. We'll leave the rest to you.」

0x005CB2.en: 「I've no intention of wholeheartedly endorsing@　the very existence of a force like the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x005D29.en: 「But I believe your account of the President's assassination.@　And that you act out of concern for Earth's future.」

0x005DE0.en: 「I wish you a good fight. That is all.」

0x005E0E.en: 「...That stubborn old head's gotten quite a bit softer.」

0x005E51.en: 「So it seems. To live up to Commander Humphrey's faith,@　let's make Operation Reconquista a success@　and free the moon from the Guests.」

0x005F24.en: 「All hands, Combat Condition One!@　We're heading for the skies above Moon Cradle!」

0x005F8F.en: 「The 4th, 5th and 6th Mobile Units are being pushed back.@　They've brought new machines just like us...@　A Liege Geios has been confirmed too.」

0x00604F.en: 「Oh dear~, Meki-chan just doesn't~ pull any punches.」

0x0060D2.en: 「Sorry about this, having to lean on you lot@　at the crucial moment.」

0x00612E.en: 「We haven't accepted all of this.@　Pull anything funny and a half-measure@　punishment won't be the end of it.」

0x0061DA.en: 「Still, never thought I'd end up fighting@　shoulder to shoulder with you.」

0x006240.en: 「Hey, can't you shut down the Bioroids'@　functions like you did the other time?」

0x0062BB.en: 「Afraid not. They've countered it now.@　Last time we got done in by the worm@　Shu Shirakawa scattered around...」

0x006360.en: 「They set a special self-lock mode for just this.@　Unless the commander lifts it,@　those things won't stop.」

0x006408.en: 「This commander's an acquaintance of yours, right?@　Can't you talk him around somehow?」

0x006483.en: 「Right, if it's a human, you can reason with them, can't you?」

0x0064C6.en: 「That's the plan, but they're not an agreeable bunch...@　and the master release code, Zezernan's surely@　keeping that under lock and key.」

0x00656E.en: 「Quit the excuses and get moving, I'd say.」

0x0065AE.en: （Good grief, strong-willed women everywhere I turn,@　there and here alike.）

0x006676.en: 「If this is about surrendering, I won't hear it.@　You people killed Roff. I'll never forgive you.」

0x0066F0.en: 「His death was regrettable...@　but I'm not the one who did it.」

0x006746.en: 「Let me add this. During my fight with Roff,@　the one who shielded him was Mekibos.」

0x0067B1.en: 「Whatever the truth, the one who set his death@　in motion was Mekibos... you.」

0x00685D.en: 「So you'll share Zezernan's fate. There's@　no meaning left in this fight at all.」

0x0068D4.en: 「Meaning...? There is one. I'll@　avenge Roff!」

0x006955.en: 「Honestly, there are~ things that don't add up,@　but we came~ to Earth with the Privy Council's@　approval~ too, you know.」

0x0069DC.en: 「And this~ is the thanks we get. Doesn't~ sit right with me.」

0x006A1C.en: 「I told you, Zezernan used a forbidden move.@　That's why the Privy Council sent me in.」

0x006A99.en: 「And how~ can you be sure that whole affair~@　isn't a fabrication by the opposition~? Maybe Meki-chan's@　just being used~ in the end, too.」

0x006B41.en: 「...I'll explain it to the Privy Council myself.@　That you two were merely being used by Zezernan.」

0x006BC1.en: 「Can't trust~ that either. There's no guarantee~@　the Council will take us~ in the way@　they took in Meki-chan~」

0x006C5A.en: 「So you've no intention of backing down, no matter what?」

0x006C94.en: 「That's~ right. Service under a lord's a thankless~ thing,@　for both of us.」

0x006D0F.en: 「Guess we've got no choice but to fight...!」

0x006D49.en: 「Sorry I couldn't meet your expectations.@　Leave Zeb and Seti to me.@　I'll settle this with my own hands.」

0x006DD6.en: 「I know how you feel, but alone it'll take too long.@　I'll back you up.」

0x006E32.en: 「Commencing Operation Reconquista, Phase 4!@　All forward main guns, open fire!」

0x006EBE.en: 「Ghost One to all units.@　We're seizing air superiority over Moon Cradle.@　Begin the attack!」

0x006F30.en: 「It's not too late even now. Stand down, Zeb.」

0x006F67.en: 「And what~ good would that do? We'd just be~ made into pawns.」

0x006FAA.en: 「Can't you see that's already@　what's happened to you...!」

0x006FFD.en: 「Seti, I never meant to kill Roff.」

0x00703A.en: 「No matter how you excuse yourself,@　he's never coming back...!」

0x00709C.en: 「Even if I accepted your offer,@　the hole opened in my heart wouldn't be filled!」

0x00711F.en: 「...Honestly, I don't want to fight you two...@　but this is my mission.」

0x00717E.en: 「I'd rather avoid a pointless fight myself.」

0x0071C4.en: 「It's what you'd call~ fighting with our backs to the water.@　For both~ of us.」

0x00721D.en: 「Sorry, but we carry the fate of our home world.@　Don't go lumping us in with someone poking@　at other people's worlds for money and power!」

0x0072E3.en: 「It's the truth that Mekibos never meant to kill Roff.@　He threw himself in front of me@　to save the man.」

0x00738B.en: 「Then it was an Earthling who killed him, wasn't it?@　You people are a dangerous race after all.@　I'll cut you down here, as an example!」

0x007439.en: 「Ngh...! I can't afford to lose here...!!」

0x00749B.en: 「Well, aren't~ you something...!@　But this isn't~ where I bow out.」

0x00757A.en: 「W-well now, this~ is a shock. You're not~ some kind of ghost, are you?」

0x007675.en: 「He was surrounded by Guest machines@　and under attack.」

0x0076CE.en: 「Zezernan's doing, most likely...@　trying to silence him, probably.@　Just the sort of thing he'd do.」

0x007780.en: 「It is. I was set upon by Liege Geios@　under Zezernan's command. That man made me a pawn to discard.」

0x00787D.en: 「I don't know how it was passed on to you...@　but it's the truth.」

0x0078EB.en: 「Well, Zeb, Seti...@　will you still follow Zezernan after this?@　In time he'll cast you two off too, to save his own skin.」

0x007996.en: 「If everything Meki-chan said~ is the truth,@　then Zezernan has no~ justice on his side.」

0x007A07.en: 「You're right... and above all, Roff's safe...」

0x007A97.en: 「Yes.@　But I can't forgive Zezernan for deceiving us...@　Mekibos, I'll cooperate.」

0x007B24.en: 「Same~ here. I won't rest easy~ leaving it like this.」

0x007B6A.en: 「Steel Dragon Squadron, I don't think this makes amends.@　But to settle my own feelings,@　let me lend a hand.」

0x007C0F.en: 「Captain, given the circumstances...@　they won't turn on us here.@　And it'll make things go more smoothly.」

0x007CEB.en: 「...Shu, what do you intend to do?」

0x007D25.en: 「We'll cooperate too.@　That's what we came here for.」

0x007D9D.en: 「I too am one who loves the Earth...@ Is there something wrong with that?」

0x007E1B.en: 「I thought you'd understood from what I said@　when last we met...」

0x007E83.en: 「My aim is to pass judgment with my own hands@　on Lord Zezernan, who used me.」

0x007EEB.en: 「And after that?@　You're not planning mutual ruin, are you?@　And then, us...」

0x007F94.en: 「You bastard... you said much the same,@　then turned your coat after@　the battle with Dark Brain!」

0x008024.en: 「At that time I was, to my disgust,@　under Volkruss's control.」

0x00808C.en: 「A betrayal's a betrayal all the same.@　And if such a notion was in you to begin with,@　isn't that why you were used?」

0x00813D.en: 「That's harsh...@　But I've no wish to quarrel with you here.」

0x0081A5.en: 「Hmph. As if I could trust you.」

0x0081CD.en: 「What on earth is it you want...?」

0x0081FE.en: 「Yeah, really. Just say it already.@　You've been asked the same thing over and over@　by all kinds of people, haven't you?」

0x00829D.en: 「My wish is but one thing... peaceful days.」

0x008308.en: 「Where do you get off saying that!」

0x00832D.en: 「Believe it or don't, as you please.」

0x00835B.en: 「Let me cut in... Shu Shirakawa's cooperation@　is welcome, as far as we're concerned.」

0x0083D5.en: 「Zezernan's marked him as an enemy.@　He'll try to take him down no matter what.」

0x008446.en: 「Yes... I'll take the role of bait.@　I want to give him his last rites myself, after all.」

0x0084B7.en: 「...Understood. I'll accept your offer too.@　That's all right, isn't it, Masaki?」

0x00852E.en: 「No help for it...@　This is no time to be squabbling with Shu.」

0x00858D.en: 「Yes.@　If anything, better we keep an eye on him ourselves.」

0x0085DD.en: 「I... I hate this...@　Working alongside my father's killer...」

0x00865B.en: 「I know how you feel, Presia. But for now...」

0x0086A1.en: 「I don't expect a warm welcome.@　If you judge that I'm acting against you,@　shoot me in the back, for all I care.」

0x008755.en: 「You don't have to tell me twice.」

0x0087AE.en: 「I'm not much, but@　I look forward to working with you as well.」

0x00880A.en: 「Now then, moving to Phase 5!@　We're descending on Moon Cradle!」
